description: A Vite + React app (vite.config.ts, index.html) pulling the whole of lodash or moment into its client bundle: default imports of both in ActivityFeed, `import * as moment` (the form moment's TypeScript docs use) in lib/dates.ts, and `import { debounce } from "lodash"` in useDebouncedSearch — lodash's root is a single CommonJS file, and Vite/Rollup can't tree-shake it, so here a named import still bundles every function. (Next.js is different: it rewrites named lodash imports to lodash/<name> by default, so the rule skips named lodash imports in files that show Next markers.)
